title: European Crash Retrieval Initiative and its cold case

tellings.quote: We are working on a cold case that I cannot go into details on, but it's super cool, super scary.

plain: A group called the European Crash Retrieval Initiative, run from Sweden, is looking into reports of crashed unknown craft in Europe, according to the astronomer Beatriz Villarroel, who is part of it along with Thomas Pinder and Alex Tal. She says they are working on an old unsolved case that she cannot describe, only calling it "super cool, super scary." She tells it as her own work, a sign that scientists in Europe are now chasing these cases too.
